list.title: Secrets
list.cap: Showing the first 500 of {{total, number}}. Narrow the search to see the rest.
list.inUseBy_one: In use by {{count, number}} service. Open it to see what uses it.
list.inUseBy_other: In use by {{count, number}} services. Open it to see what uses it.
list.emptyCreateBody: Secrets hold passwords, keys and certificates that services read at run time. Docker never shows a secret's value again after you create it.

delete.label: Delete secret {{name}}
delete.title: Delete {{name}}?
delete.body: This deletes the secret and its value. Nothing can read it back.
delete.inUse: {{name}} is still in use. Remove it from the services that use it, then try again.

errors.generic: Something went wrong on the server. Try again, and check the Bayplan logs if it keeps happening.
errors.permission: You no longer have permission to do that. Your access may have changed.
errors.hostReadOnly: This host is read-only. Changes are turned off on the host itself, so Bayplan can only read from it.
errors.noManager: No manager node is connected right now. Try again when one is back.
errors.notASwarm: This environment isn't a swarm, so it has no secrets.
errors.nameInvalid: Use letters, numbers, dot, dash or underscore.
errors.labels: Use at most 64 labels, with names up to 256 characters and values up to 4096.

error.loadFailed: Couldn't load {{name}}. Docker may be unreachable. Try again.

gone.heading: This secret is gone
gone.body: It was removed, or a new version replaced it. Go back to the list to find it.

inUse.title: {{name}} is in use
inUse.body: Services that mention it count, even with no running tasks. Remove it from them first.

value.title: Value
value.body: The value is write-only. Docker never returns a secret's value after it's created, and Bayplan can't show it, even with the reveal secrets permission.

inspect.loadFailed: Couldn't load the inspect output of {{name}}.

sheet.title: Create a secret
sheet.description: Stored in the swarm's encrypted store. You can't read the value back after you save.

name.label: Name
name.helper: Letters, numbers, dot, dash or underscore. It can't change later.

discard.title: Discard this secret?
discard.body: The secret hasn't been created yet. What you entered will be lost.

value.label: Value
value.helper: For multi-line values such as certificates, upload a file.
value.tooBig: Values can be at most {{max}} KB.
value.readFailed: Couldn't read that file. Choose it again.

rotate.label: New version of {{name}}
rotate.title: New version of {{name}}
rotate.body: Creates a new {{kind}} with the value you give, points the services that use {{name}} at it, then removes {{name}} once nothing uses it.

name.label: New name
name.helper: Services keep their file names, owners and modes. Only the object changes.

rotate.loadFailed: Couldn't read the services that use {{name}}.
rotate.gone: This {{kind}} is gone. It was removed, or a new version replaced it.
rotate.nameTaken: A {{kind}} named {{name}} already exists. Go back and choose another name.
rotate.stacks_one: {{count, number}} service belongs to a stack, so Bayplan can't change it from here. {{name}} stays until it uses the new version.
rotate.stacks_other: {{count, number}} services belong to stacks, so Bayplan can't change them from here. {{name}} stays until they use the new version.
rotate.none: Nothing uses {{name}}, so only the new {{kind}} is created.

run.label: Steps of the new version
run.doneNone: Created {{new}}. Nothing used {{name}}, so no service was changed.
run.stays: {{name}} stays until the services of your stacks use {{new}}.
run.partial_one: Updated {{updated, number}} of {{count, number}} service. {{name}} stays until the rest use {{new}}.
run.partial_other: Updated {{updated, number}} of {{count, number}} services. {{name}} stays until the rest use {{new}}.
run.removeFailed: {{name}} couldn't be removed. Remove it under {{where}} when you're ready.

stopped.service_changed: {{service}} was changed by someone else while this ran. Nothing was retried.
stopped.privileged_service: {{service}} uses settings that need Admin. Ask an administrator to rotate it.
stopped.image_unresolved: Couldn't look up the image of {{service}}, so it wasn't updated.
stopped.stack_owned: {{service}} now belongs to a stack, so it wasn't changed.
